parsed.explanation: The pigeonhole inference is invalid: 2^{n+1}-2 values in (0,1) provide only 2^{n+1}-3 internal gaps, which does not imply a gap at most 1/(2^{n+1}-1). The n=1 example (0.9,0.1) confirms (11) can fail under the stated selection. Earlier mentions of subset-sum pigeonholing merely assert the result. Replacing this passage by one using all 2^{n+1} subset sums, including 0 and 1, supplies 2^{n+1}-1 gaps totaling 1 and repairs the proof.
